class.name: Mode7Sprite2D
class.brief_description: A Sprite2D node that applies SNES Mode 7-style per-scanline perspective and rotation effects.
class.description:
Extends [Sprite2D] with a canvas_item shader that applies per-scanline affine transforms, global rotation, and horizon masking to reproduce the famous SNES Mode 7 effect (used in games like Super Mario Kart).
The warp is driven by an array of [Mode7ScanlineOverride] resources ([member mode7_scanline_overrides]), each encoding a 2x2 affine matrix + translation + pivot for one horizontal band of the output. The shader interpolates between adjacent entries per-scanline using None, Lerp, or Projection modes.
[b]Horizon masks:[/b] Optional top and bottom transparency regions with adjustable amount (0..1 fraction) and tilt angle. Both can be independently controlled, or synced to [member mode7_global_rotation] via [member mode7_follow_horizon_tilts].
[b]Region follow:[/b] When a [Node2D] target is assigned to [member mode7_region_follow_target], the sprite's region_rect scrolls each physics frame so the Mode 7 viewport tracks the target while preserving its size and aspect.
This class is the building block used internally by [Mode7TileMapLayer] for tilemap-based Mode 7 rendering.

members.member: Enable/disable Mode 7 shader effects. When [code]false[/code], the sprite renders normally with no overhead. Acts as a group enable — all other [code]mode7_[/code] properties only take effect when this is [code]true[/code].

Array of per-scanline transform entries. Each entry defines one row in the scanline table texture. The shader samples this table per-fragment to apply the Mode 7 warp. If empty, a default identity entry is created automatically on enable.
When [code]true[/code], UV coordinates that fall outside the 0..1 range wrap (repeat). When [code]false[/code] (SNES default), out-of-bounds UV becomes transparent.

Global rotation angle in degrees, applied after all per-scanline transforms. Rotates the entire warped image around [member mode7_global_pivot]. When [member mode7_follow_horizon_tilts] is enabled, this also drives both horizon mask tilts.
Pivot point (in normalized 0..1 UV space) around which [member mode7_global_rotation] is applied. Defaults to center.
Fraction (0..1) of the sprite to make transparent from the top down. 0 means no masking, 1 hides the entire sprite.
Tilt angle in degrees that rotates the top horizon culling line around the center. Positive values tilt clockwise (right side drops), matching an aircraft attitude indicator.
Fraction (0..1) of the sprite to make transparent from the bottom up. 0 means no masking, 1 hides the entire sprite.
Tilt angle in degrees that rotates the bottom horizon culling line around the center. Positive values tilt clockwise (right side drops).

When [code]true[/code], both horizon mask tilts are automatically synced to [member mode7_global_rotation] (+ offset) whenever it changes. Useful for maintaining the visual effect during turns without manual adjustment.

Additive offset in degrees applied on top of the followed global rotation when [member mode7_follow_horizon_tilts] is enabled. Lets you fine-tune the horizon angle (e.g., airship banking) independently of turn direction.

Path to a [Node2D]. When set, the Mode 7 viewport (region_rect) scrolls each physics frame so it visually follows the target node while preserving its size and aspect. Only works when region mode is enabled on the sprite.
